060/**
061 * Various ways to handle RowsModel events...
062 * These event types are generated in here
063 * <ul>
064 * <li>RowsEvent derived from RowSetEvent
065 * </ul>
066 * Multiple RowSetEvent maybe coalesced into a single RowsEvent.
067 */
068public class RowsModelEventHandling {
069  private static final Logger logger = JStuff.getLogger();
070  private RowsModelEventHandling() {}
071
072  record RowsEventSource(RowsModel rowsModel, RowSet rowSet, OperatorKind operatorKind,
073                         Object operator) {
074    @Override
075    public String toString() {
076      return sf("RowsEventSource{%s, %s, %s, %s}", objectID(rowsModel), objectID(rowSet),
077                operatorKind, operator instanceof RowsAction ? operator : objectID(operator));
078    }
079  }
080  // TODO: use UNKNOWN ???
081  // static RowsEventSource IDLE_EVENT = new RowsEventSource(null, null,
082  //                                                        OperatorKind.UNKNOWN, null);
083  static RowsEventSource IDLE_EVENT = new RowsEventSource(null, null, null, null);
084
085  /**
086   * RowSet events are coalesced into a RowsEvent;
087   * the source is represented as a RowsEventSource.
088   * The preferred way to operate on a RowSet is like "rsOp(() -> {doStuff})"
089   * (or a similar construct)
090   * which brackets the "stuff" with startRowsEvent and finishRowsEvent.
091   * This makes it simple to coalesce events.
092   * <p>
093   * But all RowSet operations may not be bracketed. If a non-bracketed action
094   * (or an action on "something else") is encountered then events are broadcast
095   * individually until... eventSourceStack is empty.
096   * <p>
097   * This is constructed as a static singleton in RowsModel.java.
098   */
099  static abstract class EnqueueRowsEventBase implements EnqueueRowsModelEvent {
100    //
101    // TODO: fix this comment, operations can be nested and/or anonymous.
102    // NOTE: Only one "operation" can be in progress at a time.
103    //       I think this is consistent with how SS works.
104    //
105
106    /** eventSource is the TOS, accumulating RowSet events from here. */
107    //protected RowsEventSource eventSource = IDLE_EVENT;
108    /** Keep a stack in the off chance of nested EventSource bracketing. */
109    final Deque<RowsEventSource> eventSourceStack;
110
111    EnqueueRowsEventBase() {
112      this.eventSourceStack = new ArrayDeque<>(3);
113      pushEventSource(IDLE_EVENT);
114    }
115
116    final RowsEventSource getCurrentEventSource() {
117      RowsEventSource tos = eventSourceStack.peek();
118      if (tos == null)
119        throw new IllegalStateException("stack empty");
120      return tos;
121    }
122
123    final void pushEventSource(RowsEventSource eventSource) {
124      eventSourceStack.push(eventSource);
125    }
126
127    final RowsEventSource popEventSource() {
128      RowsEventSource tosEventSource = eventSourceStack.pop();
129      if (tosEventSource == null)
130        throw new IllegalStateException("stack empty");
131      return tosEventSource;
132    }
133
134    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
135    //
136    // CreateEvents
137    //
138
139    // startRowsEvent - no current model - typical
140    // startRowsEvent - match current model
141    // startRowsEvent - different current model
142    // startRowsEvent - further mix - different model, same row set
143
144    // Anonymous RowSet Event - no current model for eventsNextQ
145    // Anonymous RowSet Event - event with different RowSet
146
147    // Additional strategies
148    // Merge eventsNextQ for same RowSet.
149
150    @Override
151    public void startRowsEvent(RowsModel model, Object compOrNav) {
152      startRowsEvent(null, model, compOrNav);
153    }
154
155    /**
156     * Invoke this when starting an Operation that manipulates a RowSet.
157     * Initialize info for the event in progress, becomes top of stack.
158     * @param _operatorKind
159     * @param model
160     * @param compOrNav
161     */
162    // TODO: synchronized? Possible that two thread modify at same time?
163    @Override
164    public void startRowsEvent(OperatorKind _operatorKind, RowsModel model, Object compOrNav) {
165      verifyEDT();
166      Objects.requireNonNull(model.getRowSet());
167      if (getCurrentEventSource() != IDLE_EVENT) {
168        flushPendingEvent(getCurrentEventSource());
169      }
170
171      OperatorKind operatorKind;
172      if (_operatorKind != null)
173        operatorKind = _operatorKind;
174      else {
175        operatorKind = switch (compOrNav) {
176          case RSC _ -> OperatorKind.COMPONENT;
177          case RowsAction _ -> OperatorKind.ACTION;
178          case null -> OperatorKind.UNKNOWN;
179          default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Must be RSC or RowsAction");
180        };
181      }
182      RowsEventSource eventSource
183          = new RowsEventSource(model, model.getRowSet(), operatorKind, compOrNav);
184      pushEventSource(eventSource);
185
186      logger.log(DEBUG, () -> dumpEventSourceStack("push", null, "####### ").toString());
187    }
188
189    @Override
190    public RowsEventSource finishRowsEvent(RowsModel model) {
191      logger.log(DEBUG, () -> dumpEventSourceStack("pop", null, "####### ").toString());
192      RowsEventSource finishingEventSource = popEventSource();
193      if (finishingEventSource.rowsModel() != model)
194        throw new IllegalStateException("Different model");
195      return finishingEventSource;
196    }
197
198    StringBuilder dumpEventSourceStack(String tag, StringBuilder _sb, String tag2) {
199      Deque<RowsEventSource> evs = eventSourceStack;
200      StringBuilder sb = _sb != null ? _sb : new StringBuilder();
201
202      // If not TRACE, then include info for TOS
203      if (logger.isLoggable(TRACE))
204        sb.append(sf("%s%s Source Stack (%d)\n", tag2, tag, evs.size()));
205      else
206        sb.append(sf("******* %s (%d) %s\n", tag, evs.size(), evs.peek()));
207
208      // Only add the stack if TRACE.
209      if (logger.isLoggable(TRACE))
210        evs.forEach(ev -> sb.append("    ").append(tag2).append(ev).append('\n'));
211      // Remove trailing newline.
212      sb.setLength(sb.length() - 1);
213      return sb;
214    }
215
216    @Override
217    public void postNewRowSetEvent(RowsModel model, RowSet oldRowSet) {
218      flushPendingEvent(getCurrentEventSource());
219      post(new RowsModelNewRowSetEvent(model, oldRowSet));
220    }
221
222    protected abstract void flushPendingEvent(RowsEventSource eventSource);
223  }
224
225  /** If event comes in and no current model, start flushing. */
226  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
227  static class SimpleEvents extends EnqueueRowsEventBase {
228    //protected final List<RowSetEventType> eventTypes = new ArrayList<>(6);
229    protected final Set<RowSetEventType> eventTypes = EnumSet.noneOf(RowSetEventType.class);
230
231    /**
232     * NOTE: Events that occur while processing CachedRowSet changes back to
233     * database are discarded.
234     *
235     * @param rsEventType
236     * @param rs
237     */
238    @Override
239    public void addRowSetEvent(RowSetEventType rsEventType, RowSet rs) {
240      verifyEDT();
241      Objects.requireNonNull(rs);
242      if (isAcceptingCachedRowSetChanges(rs))
243        return;
244      logger.log(DEBUG, () -> sf("####### rs %s evType %s", objectID(rs), rsEventType));
245      RowsEventSource eventSource = getCurrentEventSource();
246
247      if (eventSource == IDLE_EVENT) {
248        if (isJunitPrint())
249          System.out.println("Anonymous RowSet");
250        else
251          logger.log(WARNING, "Anonymous RowSet event"); //, new Throwable());
252      }
253
254      if (eventSource.rowSet != rs) { // IDLE_EVENT or OutOfTheBlue RowSet.
255        if (eventSource.rowSet != null)
256          logger.log(ERROR, "WRONG ROW SET");
257        if (!isJunitPrint())
258          logger.log(WARNING,
259                     () -> sf("Different RowSet: orig %s, new %s", eventSource.rowSet,
260                              rs)); //, new Throwable());
261
262        flushPendingEvent(eventSource);
263
264        post(new RowsEvent(new RowsEventSource(null, rs, OperatorKind.ANON, null), rsEventType));
265        // Note that the eventSourceStack has not changed.
266        return;
267      }
268
269      if (!eventTypes.isEmpty()) {
270        if (isJunitPrint())
271          System.out.println("merge: " + eventTypes);
272        else
273          logger.log(TRACE, () -> sf("merge: %s", eventTypes));
274      }
275
276      // Merge for same row set.
277      eventTypes.add(rsEventType);
278    }
279
280    /**
281     * Invoke this when finishing an Operation that manipulates a RowSet.
282     * All the RowSet events that occurred during the operation are
283     * coalesced into a single event.
284     * @param model must match the model associated with startRowsEvent
285     */
286    @Override
287    public RowsEventSource finishRowsEvent(RowsModel model) {
288      verifyEDT();
289      RowsEventSource eventSource = super.finishRowsEvent(model);
290
291      flushPendingEvent(eventSource);
292
293      return eventSource;
294    }
295
296    @Override
297    protected void flushPendingEvent(RowsEventSource eventSource) {
298      // TODO: add the RowSet, consider case where model == null ... UNKNOWN
299      RowsEvent ev;
300
301      // Only create an event if there were RowSetEvents;
302      // except for an ACTION with forceEvent.
303      // TODO: if needed, have a different event type for start/finish without event.
304      // TODO: is the forceEvent() stuff needed? Always generate an event?
305      if (eventTypes.isEmpty()
306          && !(eventSource.operatorKind == OperatorKind.ACTION
307               && ((RowsAction) eventSource.operator).isForce())) {
308        ev = null;
309        Supplier<String> msg = () -> sf("RowsEvent %s: No RowSet event", eventSource.operatorKind);
310        //if(isJunit())System.out.println(msg.get());
311        logger.log(TRACE, msg);
312      } else {
313        // If no event, default to ROW_CHANGED.
314        if (eventTypes.isEmpty())
315          eventTypes.add(RowSetEventType.ROW_CHANGED);
316        ev = new RowsEvent(eventSource, eventTypes);
317        //if(isJunit())System.out.println(ev.toString());
318        logger.log(TRACE, () -> sf("" + ev));
319      }
320
321      if (eventSource.operatorKind == OperatorKind.COMPONENT && ev != null) {
322        System.err.printf("\n\n***** COMPONENT EVENTS %s *****\n\n", ev);
323        new Exception().printStackTrace(System.out);
324      }
325
326      eventTypes.clear();
327
328      if (ev != null)
329        post(ev);
330    }
331  }
332
333  /**
334   * Queue event for dispatch; merge with previous event if possible.
335   * There are two event queues
336   * <ul>
337   * <li> "eventsNextQ" accumulates events for the next round of "dispatchLoop".
338   * <li> "eventsActive" are currently being dispatched.
339   * </ul>
340   * When "dispatchLoop" starts, "eventsActive" is empty. It grabs eventsNextQ
341   * and assigns it to "eventsActive" and creates a new/empty "eventsNextQ".
342   * <p>
343   * Everything is EDT, so no locking consideration.
344   * @param event
345   */
346  static void postAsync(RowsModelEvent event) {
347    verifyEDT();
348
349    // TODO: OPTIM: but is it possible?
350    //       When in EDT
351    //       If activated && !running then how can NextQ be empty?
352    // RowsModelEvent tail;
353
354    // // The dispatchLoop isn't running and there's nothing in the NextQ
355    // // then try to absorb into ActiveQ
356    // if (dispatchLoopActivated && !dispatchLoopRunning && eventsNextQ.isEmpty())
357    //  tail = eventsActiveQ.peekLast();
358    // else
359    //  tail = eventsNextQ.peekLast();
360
361    RowsModelEvent tail = eventsNextQ.peekLast();
362    if (tail instanceof RowsEvent tailEv && event instanceof RowsEvent newEv
363        && tailEv.absorb(newEv)) {
364      logger.log(TRACE, () -> "####### postAsync: absorbed " + event);
365      return;
366    }
367
368    //addToEventHistory(event);
369    eventsNextQ.add(event);
370
371    logger.log(TRACE, () -> "####### postAsync: " + event);
372
373    if (!dispatchLoopActivated && !dispatchLoopRunning)
374      startDispatcher("postAsync startDispatcher:", "####### ");
375  }
376
377  private static Deque<RowsModelEvent> eventsNextQ = new ArrayDeque<>(4);
378  private static Deque<RowsModelEvent> eventsActiveQ = new ArrayDeque<>(0);
379
380  private static boolean dispatchLoopActivated;
381  private static boolean dispatchLoopRunning;
382
383  private static void startDispatcher(String tag, String tag2) {
384    logger.log(DEBUG, dumpQueuedEvents(tag, eventsNextQ, null, tag2).toString());
385    if (dispatchLoopActivated)
386      throw new IllegalStateException("startDispatcher, dispatchLoopActivated");
387    dispatchLoopActivated = true;
388    EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> dispatchLoop());
389  }
390
391  /** Dispatch events invokeLater. */
392  private static void dispatchLoop() {
393    if (!eventsActiveQ.isEmpty())
394      throw new IllegalStateException("starting dispatchLoop, active Q not empty");
395    if (eventsNextQ.isEmpty())
396      throw new IllegalStateException("starting dispatchLoop, next Q empty");
397    if (dispatchLoopRunning)
398      throw new IllegalStateException("starting dispatchLoop, dispatchLoopRunning");
399
400    dispatchLoopActivated = false;
401    dispatchLoopRunning = true;
402    // Start working on the next queue of events.
403    eventsActiveQ = eventsNextQ;
404    eventsNextQ = new ArrayDeque<>(4);
405
406    while (!eventsActiveQ.isEmpty()) {
407      RowsModelEvent curEv = eventsActiveQ.poll();
408      logger.log(TRACE, () -> "####### dispatch start: " + curEv);
409      Utils.addToEventHistory((EventObjectBacktrace) curEv);
410      getEventBus().post(curEv);
411      logger.log(TRACE, () -> "####### dispatch end: " + curEv);
412    }
413
414    dispatchLoopRunning = false;
415    // If more events have come in...
416    if (!eventsNextQ.isEmpty())
417      startDispatcher("dispatchLoop startDispatcher:", "####### ");
418    else
419      logger.log(TRACE, "####### dispatchLoop exit: ");
420
421    // Unit tests may set latch.
422    if (latch != null) {
423      // could use: if (!dispatchLoopActivated && !dispatchLoopRunning)
424      // could use: if (eventsNextQ.isEmpty() && eventsActiveQ.isEmpty())
425      if (eventsNextQ.isEmpty())
426        latch.countDown();
427    }
428  }
429  // For unit tests.
430  static CountDownLatch latch;
431  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
432  static boolean isBusy() {
433    return dispatchLoopActivated || dispatchLoopRunning;
434  }
435
436  // Dump stuff queued up for dispatch.
437  static StringBuilder dumpQueuedEvents(String tag, Deque<RowsModelEvent> evs, StringBuilder _sb,
438                                        String tag2) {
439    StringBuilder sb = _sb != null ? _sb : new StringBuilder();
440
441    // If not TRACE, then include info for TOS
442    if (logger.isLoggable(TRACE))
443      sb.append(sf("%s%s Events (%d)\n", tag2, tag, evs.size()));
444    else
445      sb.append(sf("******* %s Events (%d) %s\n", tag, evs.size(), evs.peek()));
446
447    // Only add the stack if TRACE.
448    if (logger.isLoggable(TRACE))
449      evs.forEach(ev -> sb.append("    ").append(tag2).append(ev).append('\n'));
450    // Remove trailing newline.
451    sb.setLength(sb.length() - 1);
452    return sb;
453  }
454
455  static void verifyEDT() {
456    if (!isDispatchThread() && !isJunit())
457      logger.log(ERROR, "Should be EDT", new Throwable());
458  }
